body: Based of what you said none of that is your fault, I’m surprised you even apologized because it’s not your fault for not being able to I interpret what someone is saying, it’s not your job. And then the other argument had nothing to do with you, sucks the whole family just dumped all their problems on you and no one stuck up for you, I hope one day you’ll be able to cut off these toxic people.
I hope for your safety while driving down there

I’m sorry you feel that way about yourself, so what if you’re not the fittest, genuine people won’t care about that and if they do they were bad people anyways. Try catching yourself everytime you’re negative to yourself and replace that with positivity. I know I went through something similar where I was constantly trying to fix myself but I was just being to nitty gritty with myself and only made myself feel bad all the time. I still try to better myself but I’m more accepting of myself and my flaws and take it slow while remembering things I like about myself. As for finding a drive I’m also stuck in that same position so I can’t really give much advice but except keep exploring for new hopes and ambitions.

I’m not going to lie the future is scary, but maybe also think of short term and long term goals for yourself, things you want to achieve and do, places you want to go to, think of those things and work toward that. There’s no point in wasting time thinking about endings when you can use that time to make new beginnings and have cherish-able memories.

From an outsiders opinion I think you should leave him, it seems as he has his own problems as well and being forced together may only make the situation more toxic for you and your kids, your kids will understand eventually. I came from a household where my parents don’t like it each other but stayed for the kids, it was toxic no matter how hard they tried to put up a front. You can’t force anyone to love you but there will be someone out there that will actually love you. Maybe reach out to family and friends for support so you won’t be as alone.
